mapper.insert: INSERT INTO visitor_stats ( page_path, page_name, visit_time, user_agent, ip_address, session_id, referrer ) VALUES ( #{pagePath}, #{pageName}, #{visitTime}, #{userAgent}, #{ipAddress}, #{sessionId}, #{referrer} )
mapper.select: SELECT vs.page_path as pagePath, ( SELECT v2.page_name FROM visitor_stats v2 WHERE v2.page_path = vs.page_path ORDER BY LENGTH(v2.page_name) ASC, v2.page_name ASC LIMIT 1 ) as pageName, COUNT(*) as visitCount FROM visitor_stats vs WHERE vs.visit_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY vs.page_path ORDER BY visitCount DESC

SELECT id, page_path as pagePath, page_name as pageName, visit_time as visitTime, user_agent as userAgent, ip_address as ipAddress, session_id as sessionId, referrer FROM visitor_stats ORDER BY visit_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DATE(visit_time) as date, COUNT(*) as visitCount FROM visitor_stats WHERE visit_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(visit_time) ORDER BY date ASC
